title: eludite.browser.record input
description: Record a tab as an animated GIF, as the Web Browser window shows it: `action: start` begins taking the tab's frames at `fps` (default 10, at most 30) for at most `max_seconds` (default 60, at most 600; the recording stops by itself then), and answers at once; `action: stop` ends it and answers the GIF's path, its frame count and duration, and a thumbnail of the first frame. Frames come from the embedded engine's frame ring (browser.engine: embedded; with the external Chrome the command fails and says so), scaled to at most 960 pixels wide; a frame where the page did not change lengthens the previous one instead of adding a frame. One recording at a time. `path` is where the GIF goes (absolute, or relative to the workspace folder); it must lie under the workspace or Eludite's cache; default: `.eludite/browser/recordings/<tab>-<time>.gif` in the workspace. Use it to show a person what a flow looks like, or to keep evidence of a bug. Permission class execute. Next: stop it with `action: stop`; eludite.browser.input and the rest go on meanwhile.

path.description: `start`: where to write the GIF (absolute, or relative to the workspace folder; under the workspace or Eludite's cache).

fps.description: `start`: frames per second taken from the ring. Default 10.

max_seconds.description: `start`: the recording stops by itself after this long. Default 60.

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
